comment: Basic Training decoupling drill (B4): walk to P5 while holding the reticle on the aim board. The spec's 90-degree offset exceeds the trainer frame's +/-60 deg torso twist arc, so P5 sits ~45 deg off the board bearing from the gate-3 area - decoupled enough to land the two-pip mental model, shallow enough that the drill is physically completable. Kept clear of the light mast at (-150,150).
